comparison: CPU process compact preparation versus frozen TF32 reference, with one shared freshly fitted full-run model
scope: Selected Single interval (11063 rows), ordinary coding/noncoding and one ncRNA M9854 mask. Not whole-genome or official R validation.
timing_contract: All three cases computed sequentially on the same GPU index in a shared environment; compact cold/warm does not mean OS page-cache cold/warm. CPU/CUDA stages and parallel child wall times overlap and are not additive.
counter_contract: Ordinary frame_loads and compact/read counters already include child completions. Child endpoint RSS is neither synchronized nor a peak. Pending/transient charged bytes are ledger estimates, not total RSS/directory size. active_processes means alive, not busy.
legacy_stage_label_note: Some profiler labels retain historical GDS names; the association runs use the portable cache reader and do not import the GDS SDK.

full_run_cpu_allocation.note: Production plan allocation; selected one-GPU preflight explicitly uses four preparation children.

derived_cache_validation.frame_count_scope: ordinary frame_loads already includes child completion metrics; child frame counter is not added again
